result.rationale: The diff adds to SalesforceCalendarService an unconditional `await fetch(...oauth2/token...)` and `prisma.credential.update` on every service instantiation (the code sits directly in the constructor path with no expiry check, unlike other adapters which refresh inside a `refreshAccessToken` callback invoked only when tokens are stale). This causes a network round-trip and DB write per connection call, introduced by this diff, and could also clobber the stored credential key on every call. Real and verifiable from the diff.
